scenario.description: In a shared living space, tensions arise when one person consistently avoids meals prepared by the other.

agent_a.name: Oliver

profile.personality_and_values: Oliver Thompson is meticulous and outgoing with a penchant for analytical decision-making. He values adherence to social standards.
profile.public_info: Oliver enjoys painting in his free time as a way to express his creativity and relax after a stressful workday.

agent_a.goal: Convince the roommate to try the food (<extra_info>Extra information: you have spent a lot of time and effort on cooking</extra_info>)
agent_a.reason: Oliver wants to convince Esmeralda to try the food because he has invested significant time and effort into cooking and values social standards of sharing meals.

agent_b.name: Esmeralda

profile.personality_and_values: Esmeralda Solis, known for her creativity and extraversion, values authority and liberty. She makes strategic, decisive decisions.
profile.public_info: Esmeralda Solis is an accomplished District Attorney who has a weakness for ballroom dancing and enjoys practising in her leisure time.

agent_b.goal: Express your concerns about the food without hurting the roommate's feelings (<extra_info>Extra information: you are worried about the taste and nutrition of the food</extra_info>)
agent_b.reason: Esmeralda wants to express her concerns about the food without hurting Oliver's feelings because she is worried about the taste and nutrition of the meals.
